summary: The customer called to request a payment extension on their utility bill because of dissatisfaction with automated cutoff threats and upcoming payday. The agent empathized, successfully granted a payment extension to September 22nd with no late fees, confirmed the update, and closed the call politely.

evidence.text: I can go ahead and extend your due date to next Friday, the 22nd, with no late fees applied.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Extend the payment due date to September 22nd with no late fees.
